selection_reasoning: These two tasks form a coherent multi-hop sequence centered around andesite-themed blocks. The player must first locate andesite_stairs in the environment (which serves as a landmark/navigation task), and then mine a polished_andesite_slab that is placed nearby or along the path. The dependency is that finding the andesite_stairs area first guides the player to the correct location where the polished_andesite_slab is placed, creating a natural exploration-then-action chain. Both tasks are observable, verifiable, and don't require deep Minecraft crafting knowledge — just navigation and block-breaking skills.

edges.reason: The polished_andesite_slab is located near the andesite_stairs structure; finding the stairs guides the player to the slab's location

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The andesite stairs span from ~5,~0,~4 to ~7,~2,~6 (spawn-relative). The target is set to the center of the staircase (~6,~1,~5). The player must navigate near the stairs and face them, modeling 'player can see the target'. max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable range, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking toward the stairs.

Uses inventory_has because mining a polished_andesite_slab with an iron pickaxe causes it to drop as an item that enters the player's inventory. The player starts with no polished_andesite_slab in inventory, so having ≥1 confirms the block was successfully mined. This is the preferred rule type for mine tasks per the design philosophy.

scene_description: A small andesite monument on a cleared grassy area. The structure features a 3-wide, 3-tier andesite staircase ascending southward, leading to a polished andesite platform with polished andesite slabs on top. Andesite walls frame the sides. The player spawns on open grass ~5 blocks from the structure with an iron pickaxe.
task_text: Find the andesite stairs structure ahead of you, then climb up and mine one of the polished andesite slabs on top of the platform.
design_notes: The structure is ~5 blocks from spawn on open grass. Andesite stairs face south (toward the player) in 3 tiers of 3 blocks wide. Behind the stairs is a polished andesite platform (3x3) at y+2, with 3 polished andesite slabs at y+3. Andesite walls on both sides (x=~4 and x=~8) frame the structure. The cleared 20x20 area ensures no trees or obstructions. The iron pickaxe is sufficient to mine polished andesite slabs (stone-family blocks). The player must first identify the andesite stairs (task 1), then mine a polished andesite slab from the platform (task 2). Coordinates in voxel_count_in_box are spawn-relative.
